items.title: Taaruf: bare, chhote aur halke ajza (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered introduction, printed page 305.

blocks.text: Fiza (atmosphere) zameen ke gird mukhtalif gases ka kura hai. Us ke ajza ko bare (major), chhote (minor) aur halke (trace) ajza mein baanta ja sakta hai. Bare ajza nitrogen (78.00 feesad) aur oxygen (21.01 feesad) hain; chhote ajza argon (0.93 feesad) aur carbon dioxide (0.04 feesad); halke ajza methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton aur xenon.

blocks.caption: Fiza ki tarkeeb
rows: methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton, xenon

blocks.prompt: Carbon dioxide hawa ka sirf chhota juz hai. Yeh climate ke liye itni aham kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Agarche yeh fiza ka taqreeban 0.04 feesad hi hai, carbon dioxide zameen se nikalne wali lambi-mauj (long-wave) garmi jazb karti hai, to us ki concentration mein chhote izafe bhi zyada garmi rokte hain (greenhouse effect, 14.7); nitrogen aur oxygen, bari gases, is tarah infrared jazb nahi kartin.

items: Fiza: N2 78.00% aur O2 21.01% (bare); Ar 0.93% aur CO2 0.04% (chhote); CH4, H2, Ne, He, Kr, Xe (halke).
